dedupe_keys.name: future electricity demand time series for european countries from 2023 to 2100

description: Future electricity demand time series for European Countries from 2023 to 2100 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Wenxuan Hu, Yvonne Scholz (Karlsruhe Institute of Technology). This dataset represents the future time series of electricity demand for European countries from 2023 to 2100, aligning with the findings presented in our paper 'Future Electricity Demand for Europe: Unraveling the Dynamics of the Temperature Response Function,' published in Applied Energy. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
